statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome
The diagnosis codes are I49.9, I47.1, I49.5
The procedure code billed is CPT 93229
The denial reason code is PR-204
The service is mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is medically necessary to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
